purpose: Prevent windows, lamps, intakes and other identity apertures from being represented as floating decals/solids or revealing an incorrect exterior cap behind a transparent opening.
must_check: transparent aperture does not reveal exterior body material where reference shows cabin/interior/void
identity lens is embedded/recessed rather than floating beyond the host envelope
aperture family remains derived from the same Source revision
side/front/rear views agree on aperture placement
forbidden: opaque exterior cap directly behind windshield
floating lamp sphere or disc used as recognition shortcut
material-only fake opening where silhouette/host geometry is wrong
